assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent palpitations and intermittent episodes of syncope, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is ordered for comprehensive evaluation.
The service is coded as CPT 93247.
The denial is under Reason Code PR-204.
PR-204 references coverage limitations for this service.
